name: dots-and-boxes-functions
description: Server-authoritative game authority: moves, turn timeouts, forfeits and the abandoned-game sweep. Reuses the client's pure game engine so client and server rules stay identical.

scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e:prepare && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-dotsandlines --only functions,database,auth,firestore "node e2e/run.cjs"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --config ../firebase.json --project demo-dotsandlines --only functions,database,auth,firestore
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
